grades.quote: The problem is that each time a processor releases the lock, all the other processors try acquiring it. Thus, as modern systems use increasing numbers of processors, software designers have turned to more sophisticated spinlocks. Instead of all the threads monitoring a single memory location, waiting for it to change, each thread has its own location to monitor.
